checks: rejected first relay retries the retained encoding until actual owner receipt, then saves once
dedicated child entry mounts only recording view and its native idle close waits original discard
a close requested before the child listener and Panel handle are ready is replayed through the actual hello handshake
actual child blur/visibility does not stop capture; OS close finalizes and rejected owner ACK retains same File for one-transfer retry
lost saved response is recovered by original owner status query without repeated bytes, decode or submission
actual owner-loss event stays visible, does not stop capture and failed completion retains File/window
limitations: Actual dedicated RecordingWindow, Panel, Session, File reconstruction and RecordingOwner mounted; Tauri registry/window operations and hardware media events are controlled.
No real native dual window, background microphone, encoded audio/audibility or Apple pixel-parity acceptance. Actual App/latest-A SaveQueue checks are separate.
